name: Radar
description: Shows what is broken in a Kubernetes cluster and why, and gives coding agents the same topology, events, changes and logs through a built-in MCP server. For platform and SRE teams.

skills.name: Live issues
skills.description: Ranks live operational failures: failing workloads, stuck Helm releases, dangling references and expiring certificates.

skills.name: Diagnose
skills.description: Collects a bounded evidence bundle for one workload, GitOps reconciler or network entry, with optional reachability probes.

skills.name: Helm releases
skills.description: Lists and inspects Helm releases with history, hooks, redacted values and revision diffs.

skills.name: Prometheus queries
skills.description: Runs PromQL against the cluster's Prometheus and discovers metric names and alerting rules.

skills.name: AI investigations
skills.description: Runs an investigation with your local Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or OpenCode CLI and ends on a findings page with evidence.
